vibe: Premium, trustworthy, UK automotive/fintech. Like Airbnb meets AutoTrader. Clean, confident, plain-spoken.
copy_tone: Direct, plain, confident. Voice of someone in the industry. Use 'Apply to rent', 'View details', 'Verify identity' instead of generic AI copy.

spacing_and_layout.general: Mobile-first approach is non-negotiable. Use generous padding. p-4 to p-6 inside cards, p-8 to p-12 between sections on mobile, p-16 to p-24 on desktop.
spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Strict 12-column. For vehicle listings: 1 column mobile, 2 columns tablet, 3 columns desktop. Use gap-6 or gap-8.
spacing_and_layout.containers: Max-width typically 7xl (1280px). Cards should have slight inner padding when borders are applied.

vehicle_card.style: Clean, rectangular, subtle border (1px solid #E2E8F0), rounded-xl, no massive shadows (use shadow-sm or flat bg-white).
vehicle_card.content: Vehicle Make/Model (bold), Year/Fuel type (subtle), Weekly Price (prominent, e.g. '£210 / wk'), Operator Name with Verified Badge.
vehicle_card.interaction: Group hover effect: image scales up slightly (scale-105) within hidden overflow, border darkens.

sticky_cost_panel.mobile: Fixed bottom sheet on mobile (sticky bottom-0), z-50, backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-t border-slate-200. Crucial for conversion.
sticky_cost_panel.content: Line items for Rent, Insurance, Breakdown Cover -> Total Weekly Cost. Prominent 'Apply to Rent' button.

dashboard_styling.layout: Sidebar navigation (hidden on mobile, Sheet on mobile), top header for context, main content area.
dashboard_styling.cards: Dense, highly readable data cards. 1px border border-slate-200, bg-white. No massive drop shadows. Use neutral, minimal charts.
dashboard_styling.data_tables: Shadcn Table component. Left-aligned text, clear row hover states.

trust_badges.verified_operator: Small shield or checkmark icon (emerald green), text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-1 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1 inline-flex.

buttons.primary: Pill-shaped or rounded-lg. bg-[#047857] text-white font-medium hover:bg-[#065F46] transition-colors. No generic default blue.
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-[#CBD5E1] text-[#1A2E25] hover:bg-[#F3F1EC] transition-colors.

navigation.header: Sticky top, z-50. Solid white bg or high-opacity glass (bg-white/90 backdrop-blur-md) with 1px bottom border. NEVER fully transparent.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons/links must have explicitly defined hover states (e.g., hover:bg-emerald-800 hover:text-white).
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Framer motion subtle fade-in and slide-up (y: 10, opacity: 0 to 1) for critical content like listings.
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Accordion expansions for FAQs/Guides, subtle scale on card click, clear active states on inputs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Shadcn UI components for complex interactive logic (forms, dialogs, selects, tabs, accordions) but aggressively customize the Tailwind classes to fit the brand theme.
Do NOT use HTML <select> or <input type='date'>. Always use Shadcn Dropdown/Select and Calendar.
Never center-align large blocks of text. Left-align paragraphs, labels, and forms for readability.
Provide `data-testid` attributes on all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, key links) using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., `data-testid='apply-to-rent-btn'`).
Ensure hover states explicitly declare text colors to prevent invisible text on hover.
Implement light theme exclusively for now, matching the warm/cream aesthetics requested by the user.
The header must NEVER have a transparent background over content. Use glassmorphism or solid white.
Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetics: no generic gradients, no excessive center alignment, no generic sans-serif for headings like Inter or Roboto.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.design_philosophy: Reject generic AI aesthetics. Layered elements, generous spacing, high contrast interactive states.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.layout_rules: Avoid `.App { text-align: center; }`. Use direct children in grid. Mobile-first constraints.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.testing: MANDATORY: add `data-testid` on all interactive and crucial UI elements.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT.animations: No `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform`.
